submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 1 is the exact local layout: repaint its existing shapes with crisp native detail; its blur is only a coordinate guide, never final pixels. Image 2 is the north native strip matching the top 230 pixels. Image 3 is the west native strip matching the left 230 pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Only open turquoise shallow sea throughout; no dry land, no sand islands, no rocks. The pale upper-left in the guide is translucent shallow-water illumination and scattered thin irregular foam, fading to brighter cyan toward bottom-right. Keep native neighboring water ripple scale, fine irregular white foam network and translucent aqua facets. Preserve broad brighter foam paths shown in the guide without making a thick white mass. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. Keep the exact existing coast; no added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
